title: 2.04 / Spectrum Logo Don’ts
slide_intent: Make harmful alterations visible so designers can recognize what weakens a familiar mark.
strategic_value: Consistent shape, color and separation can protect Spectrum’s recognition across independently produced materials.
demonstration: Ten altered or poorly placed logos are crossed by red diagonals and paired with explanations in two rows.
practical_value: Check a proposed logo placement against distortion, effects, rotation, recoloring, added text, rearrangement, clutter, intrusion, abbreviation and weak contrast.

content_islands.name: Heading and explanation
content_islands.spec: Place the title upper left and the reason for consistency above the examples.

content_islands.name: Incorrect-use grid
content_islands.spec: Arrange ten marked examples in two rows of five, keeping each rule immediately beneath its specimen.
